Build your career at SCOR Bucharest, where top Romanian and international talent shape the future of reinsurance business, finance and technology – keeping SCOR at the forefront of innovation worldwide.
We are seeking a Data Engineer Team Lead to join our dynamic Tech team. The ideal candidate is an inspirational team lead, problem-solving oriented with strong analytical thinking. You will be leading a data engineering team to support the development of data pipelines amongst our IT and Data products and act as a local coordinator to ensure that our central best practices are applied.  Under the responsibility of a Lead Data Engineer, your mission will be to:Build, deliver, test, maintain data artefacts such as data pipelines & services (API) to serve data distribution while following standard best practices.Document data artefacts (code, diagrams, wiki-like documentation) to secure the comprehensiveness of your work.Collaborate within and outside your squad by partipipating to workshops or rituals (dailys, sprint reviews, design sessions) Support the delivery of trust-worthy data pipelines that serve both transactional and analytical needs, by implementing adequate tests and controls.Required experience & competencies+3 years of experience as a data engineer, data oriented mindsetProven experience in development and maintenance of data pipelines, preferably in agile projects (Scrum and/or Kanban)Proven experience with Databricks and/or Palantir Foundry is a strong plusExperience in (Re)insurance industry and / or Financial Services is a
